component.name: Alienation PC
component.summary: PC port of Alienation, bring your own game package

description.p: An unofficial native PC port of Housemarque's Alienation (PS4). The game's own x86-64 code runs directly on the PC through replacement PS4 system libraries and a Vulkan renderer derived from shadPS4.
No game files are included. Install your own Alienation package from the launcher: CUSA00062 1.00 or 1.06 (EUR, including the official update) or CUSA04430 1.00 (ASIA/KR).

ul.li: Online co-op for two to four players, with friends, invitations and a relay when a direct connection fails
Local co-op for up to four controllers on CUSA00062 1.06
Render resolution, aspect ratio, ultrawide, SMAA, FSR 1 and texture filtering
Frame rate options from 30 to 240 FPS and Unlimited, with the game itself running at its original speed
Xbox and PlayStation button prompts, Skip Intro and Exit Game
Trophies, save data per user, and a built-in updater
